advice_items.quote: I gambled on the wrong staff and they burnt me and picked myself back up and there's nobody you can reinvest into besides yourself
advice_items.summary_en: Pick yourself back up after hiring setbacks and reinvest in yourself.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用人失误跌入低谷后，重新振作并投资自己

advice_items.quote: I just talk to everybody on a regular basis communication communication for sure
advice_items.summary_en: Make regular communication with everyone your business superpower.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把沟通当作核心超能力，每天坚持与所有人交流

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: everybody in the neighborhood didn't have a job they owned something... when I became a doctor I'm going to own my practice
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on owning a business or practice rather than working a regular job.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不要只打工，要拥有自己的事业和股权

advice_items.quote: I'm the only owner no other banks no other personal or private Equity nothing it's just me
advice_items.summary_en: Retain 100% ownership without outside debt or investors and keep profits inside the business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持独资不举债，把利润留存公司内部

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money
advice_items.quote: I never saw my kids go wake up I never saw them go to bed... I sacrificed a lot of my children's youth
advice_items.summary_en: Working six days a week meant sacrificing time with his kids during their youth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 过度工作牺牲陪伴孩子成长的时光

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身普通，受父亲“邻居们都不打工而是拥有资产”的启发；成为医生后零外债独资创办并扩展创伤医疗与软件公司，29岁成为百万富翁。
guests.role_or_title: Founder & CEO (Retired Doctor), Healthcare & Software Companies

advice_items.quote: you got to dial in capturing the demand so marketing and sales is huge... you don't have a business
advice_items.summary_en: Dial in marketing and sales to capture and convert customer demand.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用好营销与销售，精准捕获并转化需求

advice_items.quote: fulfilling the service so that the client experience doesn't break... requires somebody who has a lot of operational experience to come in and build systems and process
advice_items.summary_en: Bring in experienced operators to build systems and processes so service fulfillment scales smoothly.
advice_items.summary_zh: 引入运营老手搭建系统，守住客户体验

advice_items.quote: take the money that you're making and continuously reinvest in yourself... I value myself over money which is why I'm so rich
advice_items.summary_en: Continuously reinvest your earnings in yourself and value yourself above money.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把钱持续投资自己，个人价值高于金钱

advice_items.quote: not give a [ __ ] what anybody thinks about you you have to believe in yourself... I wasn't Unapologetic about who I was
advice_items.summary_en: Ignore what others think, be unapologetically yourself, and build relentless self-belief.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别在意他人看法，毫不妥协地相信自己

guests.first_money_or_break: 曾年收入仅1.9万美元，40岁才成为百万富翁；过去三年创立线上健身与营养公司，今年年经常性收入（ARR）突破2000万美元。
guests.zero_start_advice: 别在乎别人怎么看你，毫不妥协地做自己，拥有坚定不移的自信，而且成功永远不嫌晚。

advice_items.quote: there's a lot of great products and a lot of good plans but you got to implement it right
advice_items.summary_en: Execution matters more than product or distribution alone—implement your plan properly.
advice_items.summary_zh: 产品与计划之外，关键在于如何落地执行

advice_items.quote: get the right people on the bus and it starts with the right people and then it's about the business plan financing it and good partners
advice_items.summary_en: Start by getting the right people on the bus, backed by a solid plan, financing, and good partners.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选对核心团队与合伙人，再谈计划与融资

advice_items.quote: a hunter is somebody who goes to look for new companies... a farmer is somebody who gets more business out of the existing customers... it's a combination of both
advice_items.summary_en: Balance 'hunter' salespeople who win new accounts with 'farmer' reps who expand existing clients.
advice_items.summary_zh: 销售需兼顾开拓新客与深耕老客户两类人才

advice_items.quote: in the old days it's always I earn today it's I deserve not I earn so entitlement it's a big problem
advice_items.summary_en: Reject an entitlement mindset and focus on earning your success through merit.
advice_items.summary_zh: 摒弃理所应当的心态，靠实力挣取回报

guests.first_money_or_break: 非富裕家庭出身，高中与大学期间在父亲的小企业打工；80年代初与父亲共同创办小型工业电子产品分销公司，逐步做到巅峰年营收2.5亿美元。
recommended_books_or_mentors: Good to Great by Jim Collins ("get the right people on the bus")

advice_items.quote: having an 18-month cash flow model... Revenue is awesome but you got to have cash flow to keep the doors open
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain an 18-month cash flow model because cash flow—not just revenue—keeps a business alive.
advice_items.summary_zh: 建好18个月现金流模型，现金流决定生死

advice_items.quote: Focus... no life balance, no family, no kids, no girlfriends, just business
advice_items.summary_en: Scale through intense, singular focus and discipline without distractions.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持极致专注与自律，排除一切生活分心

advice_items.quote: don't lose it... make good deals... nothing is real until you have a contract always have a contract
advice_items.summary_en: Protect your capital by making good deals and never treating anything as real without a written contract.
advice_items.summary_zh: 守住本金做对交易，凡事必须签书面合同

advice_items.quote: always make sure that you're keeping your hands above table you do everything transparently you don't do anything illegal immoral or unethical
advice_items.summary_en: Conduct business transparently and never do anything illegal, immoral, or unethical.
advice_items.summary_zh: 经商保持透明与道德底线，绝不违法越界

advice_items.quote: don't talk past the sale once you've got the sale done don't keep talking keep your mouth shut
advice_items.summary_en: Stop talking once you have closed the deal—never talk past the sale.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判成交后立刻闭嘴，切忌画蛇添足

advice_items.quote: I'm not the sales guy that's my secret is I know my strengths and I know my weaknesses... leadership
advice_items.summary_en: Know your strengths and weaknesses and lead by applying disciplined team leadership.
advice_items.summary_zh: 认清自身优劣势，以领导力统领全局

advice_items.quote: daily gratitude yeah I've got mantras in the morning that I go through meditation just staying positive man
advice_items.summary_en: Use daily gratitude, morning mantras, meditation, and positivity to overcome adversity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每日感恩冥想并保持积极心态，度过低谷

advice_items.quote: stay in the fight stay in the fight stay in the fight man
advice_items.summary_en: Stay in the fight and never quit when facing adversity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 无论遭遇何种逆境都要坚持战斗绝不退缩

guests.first_money_or_break: 在陆军特种部队（绿扁帽）服役22年，退役前一直手头拮据；退役后转行买卖企业，曾在非洲运营航空、在南美做建筑工程，后涉足风投、私募与投行，单年最高营收1100万美元。
guests.role_or_title: Investor & Former Army Green Beret (PE, VC & Investment Banking)
guests.zero_start_advice: 坚持战斗、永不退缩（Stay in the fight）。
